key_points.text: Vivek Vesvinaten is the head of research at Reliant Global.
key_points.evidence_quote: Vivek Vesvinaten is the head of research at Reliant Global, a quantitative asset manager focused on generating alpha from investing in China and other inefficient emerging markets.

thesis: The speaker argues that China A-shares are attractive for quantitative investing because the market is sufficiently liquid to absorb significant capital while offering substantial alpha from both standard factors and China-specific factors derived from alternative data. He notes that while standard factors yield an information ratio of 1.06 in China, utilizing China-specific factors increases this to 1.43, with the latter accounting for approximately one-third of excess returns.
